blocks.raw: <ExamTip>LEA questions on Architectural Design frequently cite code provisions without naming the code. "The minimum clear width of an accessible ramp is ___" is a BP 344 question. "The minimum number and size of accessible parking slots is ___" links BP 344 with RA 7277/RA 9442. "The maximum travel distance to an exit in a non-sprinklered building is ___" is an RA 9514/NBCP question. Knowing which code governs which design decision is as important as knowing the number itself.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>The most tested building types in the Philippine LEA are residential (including BP 220 Economic and Socialized Housing), educational (schools and universities), and healthcare (hospitals, clinics). Invest proportionally more time in these three before moving to industrial and transportation.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <Warn>Do not skip the parking design subtopic because it seems mundane. Philippine LEA questions on parking are highly specific: minimum stall dimensions (2.5 m × 5.0 m standard, 3.7 m × 5.0 m accessible), drive aisle widths for 90-degree parking (6.0 m minimum for two-way), ramp slopes, and the formula for computing required parking slots by building use under PD 1096. These are reliable exam questions that reward preparation.</Warn>
